required_fields.capacity_points: at least two sorted unique points
required_fields.stable_plan_identity_fields: predeclared identity fields that must remain comparable across capacities
required_fields.objectives: each objective must have PRIMARY/DESCRIPTIVE/EXCLUDED role, direction, and measurement semantics
required_fields.independent_resampling_unit: the experimental unit used for uncertainty/stability analysis
required_fields.minimum_independent_units_per_cell: predeclared per-study requirement; no universal default inferred here
required_fields.claim_ceiling: maximum inference authority if qualification passes

mandatory_guards: unstable workload identity when required -> QUALIFICATION_HOLD
missing raw receipts when required -> QUALIFICATION_HOLD
DESCRIPTIVE objectives cannot substitute for missing PRIMARY evidence
frontier promotion requires measured stability >= the predeclared threshold
important_boundary: qualification of data completeness and identity does not imply a positive dynamic-frontier claim
